correctness.rationale: For ordinary combinatorial weighted Laplacian C5, objective lambda_2 with positive linear budget, 0<q<16 and B>0, positive homogeneity reduces optimization to minimizing cost for lambda_2>=1. Reflection-even and odd two-dimensional characteristic polynomials give b=(2a-1)/(5a-3), t=(2a-1)^2/(5a^2-6a+2) and both low eigenvalues exactly 1. The exact sixth-degree Bernstein coefficients are all negative on z=5a-3 in [0,1], proving Q(a) strictly decreasing on (sqrt(2/5),4/5) from 16 to 0. Remaining eigenvalues lie above 1. Positive dual weights alpha,beta multiply squared edge differences of normalized unit even and odd eigenvectors to equal the individual edge prices, so any independent nonnegative conductances with gap>=1 cost>=C=alpha+beta. Equality makes both eigenvectors eigenvalue-one eigenvectors; their five vertex equations force all conductances individually, proving uniqueness even without imposed symmetry. Independently checked the exact q=25/16 instance a=.7,b=.8,t=.64,C=4 and Laplacian low double eigenvalue=1. The bundled verify.py symbolic identities, Bernstein representation and 1500 random comparisons were read; random comparisons alone do not prove globality. Endpoint q=0,16 excluded.
residual_risks: No uniqueness assertion at q=0 or q=16, no arbitrary masses or arbitrary priced cycles, not discrete-time SLEM.
